plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid = my value) is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected payoff regardless of others. With value $9, bidding higher risks winning at a price above my value; bidding lower only reduces my win probability without increasing profit when I win. No prior rounds to learn from, ties are random. Therefore I will bid my true value, $9. ]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding your true valuation is a weakly dominant strategy: you pay the second-highest bid if you win, so truthful bidding maximizes expected profit and avoids the risk of overpaying or unnecessarily losing. No history is available, values redraw independently, so bid my value of 40.]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction; bidding my true valuation is a weakly dominant strategy. With no prior rounds to learn from and only one round, I will bid my private value of $32. This maximizes expected profit: I win when the second-highest bid is below 32 and pay that price, ensuring nonnegative surplus.]
